name: secretEden
original_name: シークレット・エデン
source:
When the protagonist regains consciousness, he finds himself imprisoned together with two humanoids.
He learns that to escape, he must play a game with his life as the stake. He doesn't know why he is here or who brought him to this place. To escape from his mysterious prison, he has to participate in a game of death.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ044995.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
